stock.description: Ganglong China Property Group Limited operates as an investment holding company with a primary focus on real estate development across the People's Republic of China. The firm specializes in the construction and marketing of residential properties, frequently integrating essential ancillary amenities like retail outlets, parking facilities, and other supporting areas. Additionally, it develops and maintains a portfolio of diverse retail units. Established in 2007, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Shanghai, China.
